automations.name: New Lead Follow-Up
automations.summary: When someone submits your website intake form, or a call is logged as a phone lead, this adds them to your lead board and sends three emails over the next two days explaining what happens next and why to choose your firm.
glance: A website form is submitted, or a contact is tagged “phone lead”

steps.title: A new lead comes in
steps.body: It starts two ways: someone submits the website intake form (“GHL Build Out - Optin Form”), or a contact is tagged “phone lead” after a call.
steps.note: All three automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: The lead is added to your lead board
steps.body: Website leads are tagged “web lead” and placed in Stage 1: Web Lead. Phone leads are placed in Stage 2: Phone Lead.

steps.title: Email 1: We've received your submission

email.subject: Confirmed: We've received your submission!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for reaching out to The Mahdavi Law Firm and sharing the details of your incident.

Our dedicated team is now reviewing the information you provided.

In the coming days, a member of our team will reach out to you to gather more details about your situation.

Please be on the lookout for a call from our office. The details to watch for are The Mahdavi Law Firm office at [Office phone].

If you see this number, it will be our team getting in touch to discuss your case further.

We understand the importance of your case and are committed to exploring how we can be of assistance.

Thank you for choosing The Mahdavi Law Firm.

Kind regards,
[Team member's name]
[Team member's email]
[Office phone]
The Mahdavi Law Firm

steps.note: Phone leads get this email too, but it thanks them for “submitting” and “sharing the details of your incident”, which won't fit someone who called. We can send phone leads a version that says “thanks for calling”. The signature uses the name and email of the team member assigned to the lead. If no one is assigned yet, those lines come out blank. We can use a fixed signature instead (for example the firm name and intake line).

steps.title: Email 2: How our process works

email.subject: We're Reviewing Your Incident Form
email.body:
Hi [First name],

We want to assure you that your incident form has been received and our dedicated team is already hard at work reviewing the information you've shared.

Navigating through the complexities of insurance and dealing with the aftermath of an incident can be incredibly frustrating and emotionally taxing.

At The Mahdavi Law Firm, we recognize the burdens you're carrying, and we're here to lighten that load.

Here's How Our Process Works:

Step 1: Discovery
Once we accept your case, our dedicated team will carry out a comprehensive discovery phase. This involves contacting relevant insurance companies, obtaining police reports, and gathering essential information.

Step 2: Assessment
We dive deep into assessing the damages you've faced, whether it's mounting medical expenses, lost wages, or any other challenges resulting from the incident.

Step 3: Settlement
Our ultimate goal is to work towards a fair settlement with the responsible parties. Once an agreement is reached, we guide you through the necessary steps, including signing off on the settlement and receiving the funds.

To give you peace of mind throughout this process, we'd like to share some successfully handled cases similar to yours:

[Insert Case Study/Review]

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out. We are here to provide the support and guidance you need during this challenging time.

Kind regards,
[Team member's name]
[Team member's email]
[Office phone]
The Mahdavi Law Firm

steps.note: This still has a placeholder: “[Insert Case Study/Review]”. Please send us a short case result or client review to use, or we'll remove that paragraph.

steps.title: Email 3: Why choose us

email.subject: Why Choose [Insert Name Of Law Firm]?
email.body:
Hi [First name],

In challenging times like these, making the right choice for legal representation is pivotal.

We understand the gravity of your situation, and we want to share why choosing The Mahdavi Law Firm is a decision centered around your needs.

First and foremost, we acknowledge the urgency in resolving your case. Our approach is designed to get you the compensation you deserve as quickly as possible.

Our commitment to efficiency is evident in our [XX] rating on [Website], highlighting our dedication to achieving prompt and successful resolutions.

But beyond our ratings lies what truly sets us apart – our sincere compassion. We extend our heartfelt apologies for the unfortunate events you or your loved one has experienced.

Our team is not only incredibly experienced but also deeply understands the complications that Personal Injury can bring upon a family.

Choosing The Mahdavi Law Firm means choosing a partner who prioritizes your peace of mind, values your time, and is dedicated to securing the best outcome for you.

No case is too difficult or complex for us. With decades of experience dedicated to practicing law, your case benefits from the wealth of knowledge and insight we've gained over [X]+ years.

Plus, with our “No Fee Unless You Win” promise, you can rest assured that your financial well-being is a top priority.

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out. We are here to provide the support and guidance you need during this challenging time.

Kind regards,
[Team member's name]
[Team member's email]
[Office phone]
The Mahdavi Law Firm

steps.note: Three placeholders need filling: the subject (“[Insert Name Of Law Firm]”), your review rating (“[XX] rating”) and years of experience (“[X]+ years”). Please confirm the numbers, or we'll reword those lines.

questions.text: Should your team get an alert for every new lead?
questions.why: Right now nobody is notified when a form comes in. The only alert is when a contact replies.

questions.text: Should these emails stop once the lead books a consultation or signs?
questions.why: Today all three emails go out even if the lead has already booked or signed.

questions.text: Would you like a text message added?
questions.why: This follow-up is email only. A quick text on Day 0 usually gets a faster response from injury leads.

automations.name: Consultation Confirmation + Reminders
automations.summary: When a consultation is confirmed, this sends a confirmation email with the Zoom link, then reminders 24 hours, 1 hour and 5 minutes before.

steps.title: A consultation is confirmed
steps.body: Starts when an appointment is confirmed in GHL.
steps.note: All three automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve. Your account doesn't have a booking calendar yet, so nothing can trigger this. We'll set one up (or connect your existing booking tool) before going live.

steps.title: The lead moves to Booked Consultation
steps.body: The lead is tagged “consultation booked” and moved to Stage 5: Booked Consultation on your lead board.

steps.title: Email 1: Your appointment is confirmed

email.subject: Appointment Confirmation
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Your appointment has been confirmed for [Appointment date] at [Appointment time] [Time zone]

Let us know if you have any questions in the meantime 👍

When it is time, please use this Zoom Meeting ID: [Zoom link]

- The Mahdavi Law Firm

Add to google calendar | Add to outlook
Cancel | Reschedule

steps.note: The Zoom link in all of these messages is still a placeholder in GHL (zoom.us/j/xyz), so it won't open a real meeting yet. Please send us your Zoom link, and tell us if different attorneys use different rooms or if some consultations are in person or by phone.

steps.title: Email 2: Your meeting is in 24 hours

email.subject: Your Meeting is in 24 Hours!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Just a friendly reminder that our appointment is in 24 Hours.

When it is time, please use this zoom Meeting ID: [Zoom link]

- The Mahdavi Law Firm

steps.title: Email 3: Your meeting is in 1 hour

email.subject: Your Meeting is in 1 hour!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Just a friendly reminder that your appointment is in one hour.

Please use this zoom Meeting ID: [Zoom link]

- The Mahdavi Law Firm

steps.title: Text 1: Your appointment is in one hour
steps.sms: Hi [First name], just a friendly reminder that our appointment is in one hour. - The Mahdavi Law Firm

email.subject: Your appointment is starting!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Our appointment is about to start. Please join here:
[Zoom link]

- The Mahdavi Law Firm

steps.title: Text 2: Your appointment is starting
steps.sms: Hi [First name], our appointment is about to start - hop in here: [Zoom link]  - The Mahdavi Law Firm

steps.title: The reminders end
steps.body: The lead leaves this automation when the consultation starts.

questions.text: How do leads book a consultation today?
questions.why: There's no booking calendar in your GHL account yet, so this automation can't start.
options: We use another booking tool (tell us which)

questions.why: Every reminder includes a Zoom link.

automations.name: Reply Alert for Your Team
automations.summary: Whenever a contact replies by text, email or call, everyone on your team gets a text with who it is and what they said.

steps.title: A contact replies
steps.body: Starts every time any contact replies to a text or email, or calls in.
steps.note: All three automations are still in Draft in GHL, so nothing is being sent yet. They'll go live once you approve.

steps.title: Your team gets a text
steps.body:
Everyone on your team gets this text:

“New Incoming Reply / Email / Call from: [Contact name] [Contact email] [Contact phone]

Message: “[Message]””
steps.note: This goes to every user in your account, for every reply from any contact, including existing clients. Busy accounts can get a lot of texts. We can limit it to new leads only, or to one intake person.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Nothing is sent to the contact.

questions.text: Who should get these reply alerts?
questions.why: Right now every user in your account gets a text for every reply.
options: Only the intake team (tell us who)

questions.text: Which replies should trigger an alert?
questions.why: Alerting on every contact, including existing clients, can be noisy.

automations.name: Live Chat Intake (Personal Injury)
automations.summary: When someone chats with you on your website, this asks four quick questions one at a time (date, type of incident, medical treatment, best phone and email). After the last answer it confirms in the chat, adds the lead to your lead board, emails the details and sends the lead a confirmation text.
glance: A visitor replies in your website live chat
A few seconds after each reply
5 chat replies, 1 email (see the note on it), 1 text
A copy of the intake email at info@mahdavilawfirm.com

steps.title: A visitor replies in your website chat
steps.body: Each time the visitor replies, the next question is sent a few seconds later. The first reply starts the questions.
steps.note: Unlike the other automations here (all Draft), this one is already published and running in GHL.

steps.title: Chat question 1: When did the accident happen?
steps.sms: Thanks, [First name]! To check the Texas Statute of Limitations, when did the accident occur?

steps.gap: A few seconds after they answer
steps.title: Chat question 2: Type of incident
steps.sms: What type of incident was it? (e.g., Car Wreck, 18-Wheeler, Slip & Fall, Workplace Injury)

steps.gap: A few seconds after they answer
steps.title: Chat question 3: Medical treatment
steps.sms: Are you currently receiving medical treatment for your injuries?

steps.gap: A few seconds after they answer
steps.title: Chat question 4: Best phone and email
steps.sms: Lastly, what is the best phone number and email for an attorney to reach you for a free evaluation?

steps.gap: A few seconds after they answer
steps.title: Chat reply: Intake confirmed
steps.sms: Got it. I'm sending this to our team now. Someone will reach out shortly. Hang in there!

steps.title: The lead is added to your lead board
steps.body: A card named after the lead is created (or updated) in Lead Stages › Stage 1: Web Lead, with the source “Chat”.

steps.title: Email: New PI chat intake (written for your team)

email.subject: New PI Chat Intake Completed for [Contact name]
email.body:
Hello Team,

We have successfully completed a personal injury chat intake for the contact: [Contact name].

Details:
- Full Name: [Contact name]
- Email: [Contact email]
- Phone: [Contact phone]
- Date of Accident: [Date of accident]
- Incident Type: [Incident type]
- Currently Receiving Medical Treatment: [Receiving medical treatment]

Please follow up with the contact promptly.

Best regards,
[Team member's name]
[Team member's email signature]

steps.note: This email is written for your team, but in GHL it's a regular email step, which sends to the lead, with info@mahdavilawfirm.com copied. The sender also shows as “LFMP”. We recommend sending it to your team only. Also, nothing in this automation saves the chat answers into the Date of Accident, Incident Type and Medical Treatment fields, so those lines will likely be blank unless your chat tool fills them in.

steps.title: Text: Your intake was received
steps.sms:
Hello [Contact name],

Your intake information has been successfully received and recorded. Our legal team will be reaching out to you shortly.

Thank you,
[Team member's name]
steps.note: The sign-off uses the name of the team member assigned to the lead. If no one is assigned yet, it comes out blank. This text also has no opt-out wording (“Reply STOP to opt out”).

steps.title: The chat questions reset
steps.body: If the visitor replies again after finishing, the chat tags are cleared so the questions can start over next time.

questions.text: Are these the right intake questions?
questions.why: The chat asks: accident date, type of incident, medical treatment, and best phone and email.
options: Change or add questions (tell us which)

questions.text: Who should receive the intake details email?
questions.why: Right now it goes to the lead, with info@mahdavilawfirm.com copied.

questions.text: Should the lead also get the confirmation text?
questions.why: They already get a confirmation in the chat.
options: No, the chat confirmation is enough

automations.name: Chat Lead to Lead Board
automations.summary: When a chat starts, this waits for the visitor's phone and email, then adds them to your lead board so your team can follow up.
glance: A new card on your lead board
When the card is created, or after 30 minutes

steps.title: A website chat starts
steps.body: Starts when the chat intake begins (the contact is tagged “pi-chat-started”).
steps.note: Unlike the other automations here (all Draft), this one is already published and running in GHL.

steps.title: If we have their phone and email, they go on your lead board
steps.body: If the contact has both a phone number and an email, a card is created in Lead Stages › Stage 1: Web Lead.

steps.title: Second check
steps.body: If the phone or email was still missing, it checks again after 25 more minutes and creates the card if both are there now.
steps.note: If either is still missing after 30 minutes, no card is created and nobody is told. We can add a task or alert for your team in that case.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Nothing is sent to the lead.

questions.text: What should happen if a chat visitor never gives a phone and email?
questions.why: Right now they are not added to your lead board and nobody is told.
options: Alert our team so we can follow up (recommended)
